kultivator.screen.help.gulungan.title: Main Scroll
kultivator.screen.help.gulungan: One jade scroll holds every menu of the mod. Tap [[key:quick]] to open it (hold it for the Quick Access wheel). The left rail holds eight sections: 1 Self, 2 Techniques, 3 Disciples, 4 Sect, 5 World, 6 Immortality, 7 Guide, 8 Settings; the Here tablet (9) appears above them only while you are dealing with someone or something in the world. The coins in the header are the section's pages (Q and E switch), the bar under them the subs (← → while the bar has focus). Tab moves the gold focus ring, Enter or Space runs what has focus, / opens the search field, Esc steps back once until you are back in the world. The ? seal at the top right opens the topic of the page on screen in this Encyclopedia. Direct keys: [[key:codex]] Technique Codex, [[key:murid]] Disciples, [[key:guide]] Guide, [[key:peta]] Map; press again to close. Confirmations are always a seal over the page: light ones take a click, medium ones a short hold, heavy ones a tick and then a hold.
kultivator.screen.help.di_sini.title: Here Tablet
kultivator.screen.help.di_sini: When you click a townsperson, a board, a teleport disc or a service block, the Scroll opens on the page of that function with that person as the one you deal with. A function with a fixed home (the Auction under Immortality, for example) opens at its home; a service that exists only in the world (weapon shop, bank, teahouse and so on) is mounted on the Here tablet at the top of the rail. The tablet stays while the business lasts, also when you switch to another section. Walking too far away or the other party leaving ends it: the tablet goes and the scroll's footer says Conversation ended. While Here shows a dialog or a list of choices, number keys pick the numbered choice; elsewhere numbers pick sections. Prompts that arrive while you are busy (tower riddles, talisman warnings, secret realm rewards) wait on this tablet and never open a screen by themselves.
kultivator.screen.help.dialog.title: Conversation
kultivator.screen.help.dialog: Talk with townsfolk through dialog bubbles. Answers are numbered: click one, pick with ↑↓ and Enter, or press its number. The Talk tab holds chatter and news, Services opens that person's service (shop, bank, inn, other trades) as the next page with a Back to the conversation button, Errands shows the requests and quests they offer. Gestures such as a bow change their impression; people who fear you answer differently. Locked choices still show with their reason. Dialogs of the underworld and the Boundless Sea use the same page in other colours.
kultivator.screen.help.toko_senjata: The town weaponsmith sells and forges weapons by class: jian, dao, qiang, axe, mace, iron fan, whisk and armour. Pick an item in the list, see its attack, speed, durability and reach, and compare it with the weapon in your hand (green arrows better, red worse). Buying costs Stone Value; your Reputation in that town sets the discount or surcharge. Order makes a weapon to the shape, quality and materials you bring; an order is ready after some days and collected here. Repair restores durability; its price follows the weapon's remaining value.
kultivator.screen.help.gilda_misi.title: Cultivator Guild
kultivator.screen.help.gilda_misi: The Cultivator Guild's mission board is pinned anew every morning. Accept missions whose rank matches your badge (hunts, escorts, herbs, lairs), then hand them in at the counter for Stone Value, Reputation and badge points. Show on map marks the direction of the target. Badge points raise your stars; some stars need an exam at the counter. Higher stars open higher-ranked boards and extra missions per day. The Young Dragon List records the hundred best young cultivators.
kultivator.screen.help.bank.title: Money House
kultivator.screen.help.bank: The town's Money House keeps your wealth. The vault stores items and Stone Value safely (needs the Known Resident reputation); deposit and withdraw any time, withdrawals cost a small fee. A bank draft turns Stone Value into a letter you can cash at the Money House of another town. Pawn lends money against an item; redeem it before it falls due or the item is sold. Exchange trades Stone Value for spirit stones or Origin Stones at the day's rate.
kultivator.screen.help.buku_kas.title: Ledger
kultivator.screen.help.buku_kas: The Ledger records money coming in and going out: today, the last seven days and per source (tribute, stalls, caravans, tournaments, missions, rent, wages). A small chart shows the net in CP and Stone Value. The Stall tab runs your rented market stall: stock it, set prices and collect the till. The Caravan tab shows your trade caravans on the road, their cargo, guards and expected profit. Under Self the book shows your own businesses, under Sect › Treasury & Shop the sect's treasury.
kultivator.screen.help.tagihan.title: Damage Bill
kultivator.screen.help.tagihan: When you damage a place, a bill collector brings a bill listing the damage, the builders' wages and the total. Pay settles it cleanly. Haggle once for a lower price; the collector may accept or take offence. Refusing is recorded as a crime. You may also help the builders or donate materials to lower the bill and gain Reputation. A place that fears you too much does not dare to bill you.
kultivator.screen.help.peta_kota.title: Town Map
kultivator.screen.help.peta_kota: The map of the capital you are in: districts inside and outside the walls, services you already know, people you have met and events of the next few days. Point at a district for its name, click a service or person to mark where it is. The map is for viewing only; a service appears after you have visited it. Under World › Map it is the Town sub.
kultivator.screen.help.teleport.title: Teleportation
kultivator.screen.help.teleport: The Formation Keeper at a teleport station sends you to places you already know: towns, capitals, large villages, clan villages, large waystations or sect compounds whose stance is at least Neutral. The fare rises with distance and is paid per person; following disciples nearby come along. Channelling takes a few seconds and breaks if you are attacked. Wanted criminals are refused. The Sky Dock serves Cloud Travel to far destinations by day.
kultivator.screen.help.pasar_binatang: At the Spirit Beast Market you can buy young spirit beasts from the pens, sell your beasts, and leave them with a trainer to be trained. Offerings raise a beast's affinity; beast cores are bought and sold by tier. A beast's tier and traits are on its card before you buy.
kultivator.screen.help.judi_batu.title: Stone Gambling
kultivator.screen.help.judi_batu: Buy raw stones from the rack: pebbles, chunks, boulders or the rare ancient stone. Inspect one with the Inner Eye to see its skin colour before buying (limited uses per day), then cut it. Inside may be nothing, a small to large spirit stone, or now and then a jackpot. The rack is restocked every day. This is gambling: the price is not returned when a stone is empty.
kultivator.screen.help.layanan_kota: An inn gives a night's rest and restores your strength; an eating house sells dishes with temporary effects. Other town services: the Sky Temple (incense for the Temple Blessing, once a day lowers heart demon pressure), the Physicians' Hall (heals Qi Deviation), the Library and Archive (daily lectures and town records). Prices follow your Reputation in that town: Strangers pay more, the Honoured and Town Heroes get discounts. A service that is closed for now still shows with its reason.
kultivator.screen.help.sidang.title: Yamen and Hall of Law
kultivator.screen.help.sidang: The town Yamen records crimes seen by witnesses as points; points fall a little every day. From 10 points you are Suspected, from 25 Wanted (shops and stations refuse you), from 60 Most Wanted. Here you can pay the fine, turn yourself in to sit in a cell for a while, and redeem confiscated items. The same page holds the hearings of an NPC sect's Hall of Law: the case, witnesses and the judge's questions are answered from a list of choices; your Shifu may defend you.
kultivator.screen.help.acara.title: Town Events
kultivator.screen.help.acara: The capital's calendar shows today's big event and the coming ones: the Pill Meeting, the Grand Auction, the Gate Opening Day, the Grand Tournament, the Lantern Festival, the Sect Meeting, sometimes a Beast Wave. Register to take part, watch the tournament bracket, or answer lantern riddles (numbered choices) during the festival. Events only run while a player is near the town centre.
kultivator.screen.help.lapak_rekrut: On the Gate Opening Day and at the town's recruit stalls, would-be disciples offer themselves. Their card shows their spirit root and talents. Invite brings one candidate to your hall (invitations per day are limited); Rent pays for a stall of your own sect so candidates come to you. Candidates you invite appear under Sect › Members › Candidates.
kultivator.screen.help.jurnal.title: Travel Journal
kultivator.screen.help.jurnal: The Travel Journal gathers your business in the world: Active holds the errands still running, per place, with a direction when there is one; Done holds the finished ones and their outcome; Story holds the capital's tale by chapter and the choices you made. Track puts one errand on the tracker at the right edge of the screen.
kultivator.screen.help.gilda.title: Alchemist and Artificer Guilds
kultivator.screen.help.gilda: The Alchemist Guild and the Artificer Guild in the Guild District have four desks. Exam raises your guild rank when you bring the pill or treasure asked for. Shop sells materials and recipes for your rank, cheaper at higher ranks. Orders ask you to make a given item before a deadline for a reward. Appraise values the item in your hand.
kultivator.screen.help.kafilah.title: Caravan
kultivator.screen.help.kafilah: Trade caravans leave the caravan post for other towns. Ride along as a passenger, escort a caravan for a reward (bandits may attack on the road), or in an oasis town rent a camel of your own for a few days. Sandstorms delay departures. Caravans of your own sect show under Ledger › Caravan.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_kapal.title: Merchant Ship and Sea Crossing
kultivator.screen.help.tema_kapal: In a Harbour Town merchant ships arrive on the morning of their cycle and are unloaded by porters. The Cargo tab sells goods from the hold while they last. The Sea Crossing tab books a place on the Sea Crossing ship that leaves once a day for the Boundless Sea, for cultivators of Foundation and above; two of your disciples may come. No ship sails during a storm.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_galangan: The shipwright takes keel orders by ship class (some need a reputation band) and the sailmaker makes the sails. An order takes some days; the slipway takes one order at a time. Collect your ship here when it is ready.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_mural.title: Cliff Mural
kultivator.screen.help.tema_mural: The mural painter draws the town's tale on the cliff wall. Mural Tale reads out each panel; panels you have read are marked. Commission a Mural asks the painter to paint your greatest deed (a title, a boss defeated, a tribulation passed) in a niche everyone passing will see.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_sutra.title: Silk House
kultivator.screen.help.tema_sutra: The Su family's Silk House in the Water Town sells today's bolts of cloth, takes robe orders by colour and pattern, and lets you weave yourself on the old loom through a rhythm game. An ordered robe is collected here when it is ready.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_teh.title: Tea Pavilion
kultivator.screen.help.tema_teh: The Tea Pavilion brews spirit teas with temporary effects; the menu and effects are on each row, some need a reputation band. The Tea Ceremony is a longer serving with a stronger effect. The leaves run out towards evening.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_bait.title: Matching Couplets
kultivator.screen.help.tema_bait: The poet recites a first line; pick the matching second line from three choices (click, ↑↓ Enter, or numbers 1-3). A streak of matches raises the reward, given once a day; after that you may still play for the beauty of it.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_herba.title: Herb Hall
kultivator.screen.help.tema_herba: The Mountain Town's Herb Hall sells cliff herbs, buys your herbs at half their value and appraises the herb in your hand for free by counting its age rings. The Picker rank rises with honest sales and opens discounts.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_ziarah.title: Pilgrimage Season
kultivator.screen.help.tema_ziarah: During the Pilgrimage Season in the Mountain Town, climb the nine smoking landings from the foot gate to the Golden Hall and bow at each one, without flying. Register starts your pilgrimage, Stop cancels it. The Summit Blessing makes meditation on the Golden Hall terrace much stronger; there is a wait of some days before the next pilgrimage.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_lift.title: Cable Car
kultivator.screen.help.tema_lift: The Mountain Town's cable car carries passengers between the Valley Station and the Summit Station on a timetable. Pay the up or down fare and wait for the next cabin; seats are limited. At night it is closed, and now and then the rope jams until the pulley is mended.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_pasar_gelap: The Demon City's black stalls sell poisons, pills, beasts, maps, masks and stolen goods at a steep markup. Dread is the demon city's respect for you and opens rarer goods; Infamy is your bad name among the righteous. Goods of dark origin can be confiscated by righteous guards if they find them.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_kitab_terlar: Blind Mo Wen keeps the floors of forbidden scriptures. Each floor needs more Dread; the scrolls there teach dark techniques at a price in Infamy. An empty shelf is refilled later.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_kontrak: The Demon City's contract board offers targets with a rank and a reward. Take a contract, fulfil it, then hand it in for the reward, Dread and Infamy; cancelling a contract has a cost. The board refills every night.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_taruhan: At the Blood Arena you can bet on bouts: pick a side, see the odds and both fighters' temperament, then place your bet. The Blood Ladder is nine steps of ever stronger opponents; challenge the next one for prizes and Dread.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_tawanan: In the Demon City's Captives' Pen nobody is sold: captives can only be ransomed and escorted home to their village, which will remember your kindness. Without money, a Blood Ransom frees one captive if you win a special bout at the Blood Arena.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_dokumen: The harbourmaster asks you to check cargo letters. Compare each letter's weight, seal and date with the Customs Book, circle the suspicious lines, then mark the forged letter. Your attempts per day are limited.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_racik.title: Mixing Bench
kultivator.screen.help.tema_racik: Mix materials step by step: pick an ingredient, set the heat and time, retry if it fails. The green band marks the right heat. The result depends on your precision; missing materials are marked before you start.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_irama.title: Rhythm Game
kultivator.screen.help.tema_irama: Spinning Dance, Silk Weaving and the Dragon Boat Drums are played to a rhythm: press the arrow key (or W A S D) just as the note crosses the gold ring. Exact gives Perfect, slightly off gives Good. Space starts; the score and longest streak decide pass or fail.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_tawar.title: Haggling
kultivator.screen.help.tema_tawar: A themed town's merchant will haggle. Make an offer, watch the merchant's mood, and repeat up to the round limit. Mornings are friendly, the hot midday break is curt; an offer too low angers the merchant into leaving. Accept closes the deal at the last price.
kultivator.screen.help.tema_dagang.title: Trade Book
kultivator.screen.help.tema_dagang: Each themed town makes its own trade goods. Buy in the home town (per-item amounts per day are limited), sell in another town that values them more. The Prices tab records the last price you saw per town, Profit shows this week's profit against the cap of your realm, Contracts lists running sealed-crate cargo contracts. A market flooded with the same good becomes saturated.
kultivator.screen.help.sekte_kas.title: Sect Treasury and Shop
kultivator.screen.help.sekte_kas: Sect › Treasury & Shop gathers every money place of a sect on one page. Treasury: filter chips pick the Mission Office (the hall's CP pool, today's offerings against the cap, every stack in your bag as a card you can offer, lost sect arts with Restore), the Ledger, the independent disciples' Pocket Money, or Treasury Politics when you belong to an NPC sect. CP Shop: your hall's Yue Lu Pavilion or an NPC sect's Service Pavilion; the Source chip picks between them when you have both. Scripture Shelf, Tomb and Caravan are for hall owners only.
kultivator.screen.help.sekte_paviliun: The Scripture Shelf keeps the sect's technique books: pick a shelf and a book to see who is reading it, and Deposit puts a book from your bag on it. The Ancestral Tomb holds the graves of fallen disciples, the sect's Lineage Book and the offering altar in one scroll under headings. Data is asked fresh every time the page shows.
kultivator.screen.help.gabung_lamaran: The Application page marks each entry requirement green or red: minimum realm and root, Bone Age, the sect's stance towards you, Infamy by alignment and your capital crime record. Pick an entry gate: Gate (take the Exam Day every 10 world days), Token (a Sect Ascension Token removes the Bone Age requirement), Invitation (a letter from a tournament), Servant (no style exam) or Guest (Guest Elder, Foundation and above). Demonic sects like Infamy.
kultivator.screen.help.gabung_putusan: After the Exam Stair, the Style Exam and the Heart Exam, the Admissions Elder reads out your final score and the verdict: rejected, Registered Disciple, Outer Disciple or higher. The result card shows each stage's score. Accept the verdict to go on to the Oath Ceremony, or decline and try again on the next Exam Day.
kultivator.screen.help.gabung_shifu: A Special Candidate is contested by two or three elders. Each elder's card shows their style, temperament and office; choose one as Shifu from the list of choices (numbers, ↑↓ Enter or a click). The Master Bond rises with duties, missions and lessons; your Shifu defends you at the Hall of Law, teaches techniques and comes when you are attacked on sect ground.
kultivator.screen.help.gabung_kartu: The Member Card of the NPC sect you belong to: rank, personal CP, your Shifu and your bond with them, the Shifu's requests, the entrusted disciples you registered, and your Violation Record. The way out is here too: an honourable Farewell (with a Letter of Blessing when every requirement is met) is checked requirement by requirement. Personal CP can never be exchanged for spirit stones.
kultivator.screen.help.gabung_pangkat: The NPC sect's Rank Tree: Servant, Registered, Outer, Inner, Core, then a branch to Heir or to Elder and Vice Leader, both leading to Leader; Guest Elder is a side path. Each node shows its requirements (realm, exam, CP multiplied by the sect class). Apply for promotion from here; the ceremony is held in the hall. Core seats are limited and can be challenged.
kultivator.screen.help.gabung_paviliun: An NPC sect's Service Pavilion sells techniques, Sect Heritage Techniques, pills, treasures, materials and secret realm quotas for personal CP. Kind chips filter the goods. Higher ranks get discounts and goods of the sect's Dao style are cheaper; technique quality is capped by the sect class and your rank. Sect Heritage Techniques are bound by rules: leaking one without Blessing is a violation.
kultivator.screen.help.gabung_papan: An NPC sect's Mission Board is drawn every world day, from rank E up to the highest rank of the sect class, paid in CP. Besides hunts, escorts, herbs and lairs there are sect missions: harvesting the herb garden, deliveries to allied sects, pill orders, spying and group missions. A failed or expired mission gives no CP and adds a little to your Violation Record.
kultivator.screen.help.gabung_kediaman: Servant to Outer Disciples sleep in the Dormitory; from Inner Disciple you may rent a better cave by rank (Small Cave, Vein Cave, Private Peak, Cloud Pavilion). Rent is paid in CP every 7 days. A cave raises your cultivation speed, becomes the destination of the Homing Talisman, and its chest keeps your items. The Spirit Pool gives meditation sessions with a bonus.
kultivator.screen.help.gabung_politik: For high-ranking members of an NPC sect: the sect Treasury (donate the item in your hand, see the cash flow), Branches (Core Disciples and above may make their hall a branch of the sect), War (the War Call and war missions while the sect is at war) and elections (candidates from player members of Core Disciple rank and above). These parts live on the matching Sect pages: Treasury & Shop, Territory › Branch and Outside › War.
kultivator.gui43.p8.panduan.luring: Progress needs a server with Kultivator.
kultivator.gui43.p8.luring: Needs a connection to a Kultivator server.
